papers.title: Exact Newton calculus for tangles with a moving meridian
papers.status: Draft; exact all-level typed moving-meridian calculus and original finite tree contraction, without an analytic or volume conclusion

Canonical polynomial reduction and product compatibility from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Propositions 2.1–2.2; reduced Kashaev comparison from Theorem 10.1 only for N>=3.

The standard nilpotent/unrolled ribbon-tangle framework is cited through ADO, GPT and CGP. The physical normalization, duality, partial trace, typed turns and finite kernel are proved in this companion; no claim is made to reprove every categorical Reidemeister fact.

papers.title: Pyramids, prisms, and complete geometry of Conway closures
papers.status: Draft; actual complete augmented metric, primitive cusp basis and absolute stationary volume for the completed/completed root grammar
imports: The exact grammar, unique strict stationary point and leaf window from Newton coefficients and positive sources for Conway tangles, Definition 2.1, Proposition 5.3 and Lemma 6.1.
Newton Corollary 5.4 is used only for the separate eventual positive pure-source limit, not to prove the metric.
The classical ideal-tetrahedron Lobachevsky volume formula. Convex assembly, literal cut topology, entire face maps, complete cusp decoration and primitive area calculation are proved in the paper.
No nearby deformation, filled-knot volume theorem, signed-source estimate or broader strict-syntax geometry is claimed.

papers.title: Complementary color bounds for Conway tangle sources

The unique strict stationary point and completed-child boundary inequalities from the same paper, Proposition 5.3 and Lemma 6.1.

The two committed rational supporting-plane certificates, verified with outward arithmetic and complete domain coverage. The signed recurrence and uniform bounds through its root collisions are proved here.
No nonzero filled-invariant asymptotic, action-volume identity or extension to a bare closing leaf is asserted.

papers.title: Marked deformations and long fillings of Conway closures
papers.status: Draft; classical framed deformations, independently long primitive fillings and absolute volume for the completed-root grammar
imports: The actual complete augmented metric, original cut and primitive cusp basis from Pyramids, prisms, and complete geometry of Conway closures, Theorem 1.2 and Section 7; the complete internal Hessian from Newton coefficients and positive sources for Conway tangles, Proposition 5.3.

The framed-neighborhood metric completion of Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links, Proposition 6.1, after checking its hypotheses; its peripheral volume differential, equation (7.3), and same-chain comparison, Section 7.3.

The classical potential, full group relations, primitive logarithms, independent signed slope equations and Conway volume normalization are proved here. Identifying this action with the leading term of a quantum source remains a separate analytic input.
